name: Ubi West
summary: West of Ubi toward Kaki Bukit / Eunos edges — DTL-adjacent quieter industrial-residential living with practical rents and community-sport catchment.
body: Ubi West is the shortlist when quieter DTL edges and practical rents matter more than nightlife adjacency. The pocket sits west of Ubi toward Kaki Bukit / Eunos edges; housing mixes HDB, mid-age walk-ups, and selective condo stock. Expats land here for car-light hops to Paya Lebar / Bugis and ActiveSG / community-sport catchment without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: industrial-edge weekday noise, overnight guest caps that differ by estate, and confusing Ubi vs Ubi West shortlists. Compare with Mattar Fringe for denser mid-town, Tai Seng North for CCL industrial edges, and Eunos when east-side food density wins.
